Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep emerald-green malachite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green concentric banding swirling through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface.
